source.review_scope: Pinned CMake source configuration only; no configure, compile, link, package, or binary inspection was performed.

source_evidence.finding: The core CMake root adds ort-utils, bin-tokenizer, and moonshine-tts subdirectories without a surrounding feature option.
MOONSHINE_SRC_FILES lists the C API, streaming model, transcriber, resampler, VAD, speaker diarizer, clone-clip, embedding, and text-embedder translation units.
cpp-annote, KISS FFT, and kaldi-native-fbank sources are appended to MOONSHINE_SRC_FILES; the source list is used by the main library target.
The moonshine target receives MOONSHINE_SRC_FILES; static versus shared selection depends on platform conditions and MOONSHINE_BUILD_SHARED.
The moonshine target includes ort-utils and tokenizer headers and links bin-tokenizer and ort-utils in the framework path.
Non-framework builds link bin-tokenizer and ort-utils; MOONSHINE_TTS_BUILD_ONNX conditionally links moonshine_tts_ort and sets the TTS C API compile definition.
ort-utils adds the vendored ONNX Runtime and Moonshine utilities subdirectories and defines the ort-utils static library.
ort-utils includes the vendored ONNX Runtime headers and links the selected ONNX Runtime library.
ort-utils-test and ort-utils-ep-test are separate executables with doctest include paths.
bin-tokenizer is a static library linked with moonshine-utils and is always added by the core CMake root.
bin-tokenizer-test is a separate executable and uses the vendored doctest include directory.
The TTS subdirectory unconditionally defines the utf8proc target and moonshine_tts_core with TTS/G2P sources before the ONNX option.
TTS/G2P command-line utilities and core test executables are declared before MOONSHINE_TTS_BUILD_ONNX; that option defaults to ON.
The ONNX option guards moonshine_tts_ort, its TTS/G2P source list, command-line executables, and additional ONNX tests.
Native C API tests, memory tests, and the model-download smoke utility are declared as executable targets outside a global test-build option.
The C++ API test and benchmark executable are separate targets; benchmark links the main library and Moonshine utilities.
Transcriber, streaming smoke, and streaming-memory test executables are declared with test-only include paths and support inputs.
Word-alignment and speculative-decode benchmark executables are declared independently of the production library target.
MOONSHINE_RELIABILITY defaults OFF and gates sanitizer settings; MOONSHINE_SANITIZER is a cache string defaulting to address,undefined.
The reliability option gates a concurrency test target; it is not a global switch for the other test and benchmark executables.
The CMake source list contains streaming, model-catalog, cloning, embedding, and text-embedding code, but does not identify Outflow's model weight file set or language selection.

build_options.name: MOONSHINE_TTS_BUILD_ONNX
build_options.effect: When ON, defines the TTS ONNX library and TTS/G2P ONNX tools, links moonshine_tts_ort into moonshine, and sets the TTS C API definition. When OFF, it does not gate moonshine_tts_core, utf8proc, or the utility and core-test targets declared before the condition.

build_options.name: MOONSHINE_RELIABILITY
build_options.effect: Enables sanitizer/reliability instrumentation and gates selected reliability-only targets; it is not a general test or benchmark disable switch.

build_options.name: MOONSHINE_SANITIZER
build_options.effect: Selects the sanitizer set for reliability builds; it does not select an inference execution provider.

build_options.name: MOONSHINE_BUILD_SHARED
build_options.conditional_expression: if (NOT MOONSHINE_BUILD_SHARED AND (IOS OR MOONSHINE_BUILD_SWIFT OR WIN32 OR EMSCRIPTEN))
build_options.effect: Affects static versus shared library selection, but no declaration or default is present in the reviewed CMake files.

build_options.name: MOONSHINE_BUILD_SWIFT
build_options.conditional_expression: if (NOT MOONSHINE_BUILD_SHARED AND (IOS OR MOONSHINE_BUILD_SWIFT OR WIN32 OR EMSCRIPTEN))
build_options.effect: Affects the static framework path, but no declaration or default is present in the reviewed CMake files.

features.name: Core streaming STT

build_control.assessment: The intended moonshine library target contains the streaming-model and transcriber source entries; no Outflow-specific target configuration has been run.

features.notes: Required app capability. CMake source references establish source-level support, not an English-only or one-model binary.

features.name: ONNX Runtime inference

build_control.assessment: ort-utils includes and links the vendored ONNX Runtime library and the main target links ort-utils. The selected Outflow runtime binary/provider is not known.

features.notes: Required for the intended inference path; no CPU-only provider or artifact certification is inferred from these link declarations.

features.name: Binary tokenizer

build_control.assessment: The core root always adds bin-tokenizer and the main target links it. The selected English model's exact tokenizer assets remain unknown.

features.notes: Source-level tokenizer library inclusion is confirmed; model-specific tokenizer files and package contents are not.

features.name: Audio preprocessing

build_control.assessment: The main source list contains resampler and VAD translation units. CMake does not establish which are needed by the selected Outflow path or which objects survive linking.

features.notes: Audio conversion is part of the intended end-to-end stream; this source list is not a proof that every preprocessing module is needed.

features.name: CPU-only inference configuration

build_control.assessment: The reviewed CMake files link an ONNX Runtime library but do not declare a verified Outflow CPU-only provider-selection option or identify the selected platform runtime build.

features.notes: CPU-only is an Outflow requirement; upstream build support and platform execution behavior remain unverified.

features.name: Speaker diarization

build_control.assessment: speaker-diarizer.cpp and cpp-annote/feature-extraction sources are appended to the main target source list without a diarization-disable condition in the reviewed CMake.

features.notes: Outflow does not require diarization. Source-list inclusion is confirmed; no compiled-binary or dead-stripping conclusion is made.

features.name: Text-to-speech and grapheme-to-phoneme

build_control.assessment: The verified option defaults ON and OFF removes the ONNX TTS library/link path, but the TTS subdirectory, moonshine_tts_core, utf8proc target, and pre-option utilities/tests remain declared.

features.notes: TTS/G2P is outside Outflow's single-model dictation scope. Setting the known option OFF is not evidence that all TTS/G2P source and targets are excluded.

features.name: Upstream test executables

build_control.assessment: Test executables are declared in the reviewed subprojects; no global BUILD_TESTING or equivalent disable option was identified in the reviewed files.

features.notes: Tests remain necessary as a separate validation activity, but their executables and doctest support are not part of the intended release runtime.

features.name: Benchmark executables

build_control.assessment: Benchmark targets are declared as executables; no reviewed build option gates the general benchmark targets.

features.notes: Benchmark tools are useful for development but are not required in the shipped runtime.

features.name: Optional utilities

build_control.assessment: The TTS option gates ONNX-dependent TTS/G2P utilities, but the model-download smoke tool and other non-TTS utilities are declared outside that gate.

features.notes: Development utilities, model-download smoke tooling, and optional command-line programs are not part of the Outflow runtime.

features.name: Auxiliary model and voice-cloning code

build_control.assessment: The main target source list includes clone-clip, Gemma embedding, and text-embedding translation units; no verified option gates these entries.

features.notes: The source configuration includes code beyond streaming STT. This does not establish that any corresponding extra model weights are packaged.

features.name: One English streaming model asset set

build_control.assessment: The inspected CMake files do not select model weights, model language, tokenizer/config files, or package contents. The project model inventory remains planned.

features.notes: One English streaming model per installer is the product intent; the exact model revision, companion files, and hashes remain for T-013.

unresolved_build_questions.question: Which ONNX Runtime build and execution-provider configuration will provide CPU-only inference on each Outflow target without GPU providers?
unresolved_build_questions.resolution_evidence: Record the selected provider configuration, platform artifact provenance, and CPU-only runtime test results after an approved native build.

unresolved_build_questions.question: Which exact English streaming model revision and tokenizer/config/supporting files form the single installer asset set?
unresolved_build_questions.resolution_evidence: T-013 must record the immutable model revision, exact file list, and SHA-256 values; no files are downloaded by this task.

unresolved_build_questions.question: Can speaker-diarizer.cpp, cpp-annote, KISS FFT, kaldi-native-fbank, and related include paths be removed or isolated without breaking the selected STT target?
unresolved_build_questions.resolution_evidence: A future approved CMake change must be followed by target dependency review and compilation; no change is made here.

unresolved_build_questions.question: How can the full moonshine-tts subdirectory, its core targets, utilities, and tests be omitted from the Outflow build while preserving required STT targets?
unresolved_build_questions.resolution_evidence: The existing MOONSHINE_TTS_BUILD_ONNX option only gates part of the subtree; any wider gate requires upstream CMake design and review.

unresolved_build_questions.question: How should upstream test executables and doctest references be gated or omitted from the production build graph?
unresolved_build_questions.resolution_evidence: No global test-disable option was found in the reviewed CMake files; verify the selected target build and package separately.

unresolved_build_questions.question: How should benchmark executables be gated so they are not part of an all-target production build?
unresolved_build_questions.resolution_evidence: The benchmark targets are declared directly; introduce no new option until upstream ownership and target semantics are reviewed.

unresolved_build_questions.question: Which non-product utilities remain in a default all-target build, and what explicit target set should Outflow build?
unresolved_build_questions.resolution_evidence: Review target dependency graphs and packaging rules after a separately approved native build configuration exists.

unresolved_build_questions.question: Can auxiliary clone, embedding, catalog, and text-embedding translation units be separated from the main streaming STT library?
unresolved_build_questions.resolution_evidence: Confirm source dependencies and exported C API requirements before proposing source-list changes.

unresolved_build_questions.question: Which supported OS/architecture configurations and minimum CPU instruction sets will be built and verified for Outflow?
unresolved_build_questions.resolution_evidence: Use the project target matrix and native platform build evidence; CMake source conditionals alone are not platform certification.

unresolved_build_questions.question: What exact ONNX Runtime binary or source build, checksum, ABI, transitive notices, and link mode will each installer use?
unresolved_build_questions.resolution_evidence: Resolve artifact provenance and notices through the dependency audit before compiling or packaging.

unresolved_build_questions.question: After configuration, which objects and transitive dependencies are actually compiled and retained in the selected moonshine target and installer?
unresolved_build_questions.resolution_evidence: Only an approved configure/build followed by link-map, package, binary, size, and runtime inspection can answer this.
